description: Source code implementing MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) based RNN operations, including LSTM forward and backward passes, tensor shape utilities, and integration with PyTorch tensors.

classes.name: MPSCachedGraph
classes.description: Base class for caching MPS graph computations.

methods.name: getTensorShape
methods.description: Utility function to extract tensor shape from MPSGraphTensor object.

methods.name: getMPSTensorsFromPytorchTensors
methods.description: Converts PyTorch API tensors to MPS API tensors, handling bidirectional and bias configurations.

methods.name: _lstm_mps
methods.description: Performs forward pass of LSTM using MPS, handling multiple layers, bidirectionality, batching, and dropout.

methods.name: lstm_mps_backward
methods.description: Computes backward gradients for LSTM using MPS, supporting bidirectional and multi-layer configurations.
